newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Authority won't oppose Brambles bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Authority won't oppose Brambles bid.

text.p: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission on Friday said it would not oppose the proposed takeover of document exchange firm Ausdoc Group Ltd by transport group Brambles Industries Ltd.
It said the finding was based on the view that other companies did not find it difficult to enter this market.

Brambles said earlier this month it would not raise its A$2.00 per share bid in response to a finding in an independent experts report that the stock was worth up to A$2.61. Ausdoc shares ended two cents lower at A$1.98 on Friday. The Brambles bid ends on February 28. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
